svg.title: Local participation in a multi-community host
svg.desc: Local rooms remain in SQLite. Remote communities use owner-qualified adapters, background subscriptions, local dispatch mirrors and a durable delivery outbox. One independent host has host-wide sign-in and tenant-scoped data. Host administration is separate from ordinary membership; scoped takedown and evidence operations are explicit exceptions. Installation grants own their enrolled agents. Authoritative removal purges local mirrors; unknown errors do not.
